comparison.objective: Install a pressure-relief wheelchair cushion in the correct orientation.
comparison.physical_skill: Recognize orientation, rotate a bulky cushion through regrasping, and lower it between guards.
comparison.success_condition: Cushion is correctly oriented, flat, centered, near the backrest and still; wrong orientation earns zero. No separate spec versions are available.
comparison.reason: Bulky-object reorientation and placement are materially different from precision tool access and dynamic damper adjustment.
